scenedefault.saved: Saved what you fly now (walls, floating-voxel cleanup, scene size, collision ceiling, wind) as this scan's default in the catalogue draft. Publish the draft on the admin page.
scenedefault.keptScale: Scene size x{s} is beyond the catalogue's x4, so the scan keeps its own size.
scenedefault.keptWind: The live wind at the place is today's weather, not a default: the scan keeps its own wind.
scenedefault.fail.not-in-catalogue: This scan is not in the catalogue. Add it on the admin page first.
scenedefault.fail.session: Your admin session has ended. Sign in on the admin page and try again.
scenedefault.fail.refused: The server did not accept the draft. Nothing was saved.
scenedefault.fail.network: No connection to the server. Nothing was saved.
